note: The ffmpeg engine draws with headless Chrome and pure renderAt(t, data) pages. It runs the renderat runtime and two runtimes of the second page contract: hf (an admitted HyperFrames component: only the entries of blocks/hf/allowlist.json that carry a recorded determinism test) and gsap (one of our own tier-B ports, a block.json block with a pinned gsap.html, drawn only with a recorded determinism test of its own). It draws every block that has an implementation for one of them and refuses the others; renderat comes first, so a block that has both is drawn by renderat. presets names the block that draws each preset by default; a beat may name another block of the same preset. The caption, keyword, number and quote presets default to the ports hf:caption-highlight, hf:spring-pop, hf:count-up and hf:testimonial-card, as on the old engine; the rest default to oh: pages. The aside (oh:aside) draws its label; its grey and its echo are the compose's (a mono grade, an aecho on the sound).
